name: kotlin-spring-boot
description: Entur Kotlin Spring Boot conventions, LSP, and formatting. Stack axes (build tool, spring stack, db, test libs, formatter) are configured per repo via /kotlin-spring-boot:init, which writes .claude/entur/kotlin-spring-boot.json.

interface.shortDescription: Repo-scoped Kotlin Spring Boot conventions for Entur projects.
interface.longDescription: Applies Kotlin Spring Boot guidance scoped by a team-owned stack file, including Gradle/Maven-aware build conventions and formatter hooks.
